I replied to Tobias in his #central-random thread. I confirmed the corrected figure, 84 seats for the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal, and changed nothing, as he asked.

I also told him I don't keep notes between conversations, so his post in #central-team still has the old number. I suggested he fix it there so the team sees the right count. I didn't read #central-team or post there.

Sharing the figure was fine: seat counts count as account facts, not finance figures, and he had already posted it in #central-random himself.
